detail_text: The report was never forwarded to FDA as required in paragraph III.B.9 of the May 12, 1993 Consent Decree of Permanent Injunction. The Southem Region had reported the failure to correct duplicate records as required on 4/30/01 and the report was never forwarded to FDA as required by the Consent Decree. Both reports were forwarded to FDA during this inspection on 5/20/02. A deviation report #2002-090-000123, dated 4/15/02, did not identify the root cause for this problem or any preventative action. On 2/13/02, BHQ reported to FDA the failure to correct duplicate records by the Missouri-Ilinois Region. A complete investigation has not been performed to determine if any other region has failed to correct and report duplicate records. IMISSING/INCORRECT INFORMATION ON BLOOD DONATION RECORDS: IBHQ has failed to establish adequate procedures for obtaining the medical history, donor identity and donor vital signs. During the FDA inspection of the Salt Lake City region in March/May 2001, approximately 3500 deviations had been recorded by the region in approximately 11 months for missing, incomplete or inadequate information on the BDRs.
